name: google-ads-keyword-and-quality-score-analysis
description: Use for "which keywords make money", "my quality score dropped", "should I use exact or broad match", "which keywords are worth more budget", "why is my cost per click so high", "find me new keywords to bid on" — even when the user never says "keyword".
